summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' challenge at START Hack Munich: analyze Soony's confidential launch data and build a deployed product that rechecks the launch plan on every portal drop, finds contradictions, and acts via supplier emails/calls with human approval.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses the Sunday 20:00 launch (overbooked art-book receipt, failed statue lot, sleeve revision conflict, game-card shortfall) and built a FastAPI/React app with Today, Launch, Routines and Suppliers pages, voice two-step decisions, a team pipeline on every portal drop, generalized site/cutoff handling and a new data-shape check. Many commits are local only, awaiting approval to push to jonas/today-flow; Launch display of the data check is still pending.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhooks. Files are replaced in place, so change detection must compare SHA-256 checksums.
Challenge data is confidential: it lives in gitignored data/ and never goes into code, commits or external requests.
Approving on real data sends real supplier emails, so tests and screenshot scripts must mock every non-GET request.
Team conventions: ask before every push, no em dashes, no attribution trailers, no PRs without asking, never print tokens.
The server runs uvicorn without reload in tmux (ask-soony-app) behind a Cloudflare tunnel, so backend changes need a manual restart.
Spreadsheets are recognised by columns, not filenames, so renamed columns are silently skipped. The new datacheck module warns about this instead of failing silently.
Hardcoded 'Hamburg' and 'trucks' wording was Soony-specific. The delivery site now comes from sites.csv, and the cutoff label is meant to become per-customer data.
Voice decisions now need prepare_decision, then decide with a one-time token and confirmed=true. Tokens are stored in data/state/voice_tokens.json with a TTL of 600 s.

code.finding: Added the prepare_decision tool and made decide require a one-time token (TOKEN_TTL_S=600) matching card, decision and option, which prevents voice decisions made without a real confirmation.
New module feeding the Launch page through build_state()'s 'launch' field (parts, hours_left), derived from the verifier's dispatch.json and open_shipments.csv.
forToday never borrows another card's stop time. It uses ed.stops_at only when breaks_first_card matches the card, otherwise card.runs_dry, otherwise null.
Arrivals are now counted, and the part key falls back to material_id, then item, then supplier_part_no. This corrected the game-card gap from 34,800 to 6,800.

workflow: The subagent cross-check of 200 order confirmations and 59 scans surfaced discrepancies that the SAP data hid, such as the 80,000 vs 8,000 art-book receipt.
Parallel UI builder subagents edit the same files (Today.tsx, api.py), so ownership has to be stated and fixes routed with SendMessage to avoid conflicts.
Verifying live with Playwright screenshots against the running server catches problems that tests and builds miss.

friction: The portal token was empty at first, so the API returned 401 and data work was blocked.
Concurrent edits from multiple builders to api.py and Today.tsx risked clobbering and broke builds temporarily.
The voice assistant announced it would explain, then acted without a spoken yes and the UI jumped to Done. This needed a server and client two-step fix.
The user repeatedly rejected cluttered or unprofessional designs, fake Undo and one-tap email sending. Today and Plan kept overlapping until Plan became Launch.
The 3 existing tests broke when decide required a token and had to be updated to the two-step flow.
A circular import appeared while wiring the datacheck module.
Entire only checkpoints when repo files change, which initially looked like the hooks had not fired. Codex hooks still need approval in /hooks.
Zsh `$var:` modifier issues broke some shell commands.
open_items: Push the local commits to jonas/today-flow (needs the user's OK) and decide how to handle PR #5 versus main.
Show the datacheck warnings (changed columns, files nobody reads) on the Launch page, and add an 'Ask Nils (IT)' action.
Make the cutoff label ('trucks') a per-customer setting in the UI, since it still appears in about 30 places.
Run a live voice call with a microphone to verify the two-step flow end to end.
Voice-confirmed decisions on an on-screen-edited email send the original draft, because decide takes no text.
Editing the text of non-email messages before approving was lost with the old Plan decision pane.
Register sender addresses in the portal and send the Karton Nowak art-book order (offer valid 24 h) and the Boise terms reply.
Clarify whether portal data and supplier replies differ per team (ask the Lio engineers).
Write the README, demo script, video (max 3 min) and deck for the Sunday 12:00 hand-in.
Decide whether to delete the earlier Claude doc, and clean up the stray .vite/ cache folder in the repo root.
Change the portal password that was pasted in Discord after the hack.
